question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Keep at bay

options.text: To hold off or keep distant

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Keep at bay"** means to hold off or keep something at a distance, preventing it from coming closer or causing harm. (दूर रखना) • **Example:** The villagers worked together to keep the wild animals at bay during the night. • **Explanation:** The correct meaning of "keep at bay" is to maintain control or prevent something undesirable from approaching or affecting you. (दूर रखना) • **Example:** Regular exercise and healthy eating help to keep health issues at bay. • Hence, the correct meaning of "Keep at bay" is to hold off or keep distant. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2 - To completely remove** (पूरी तरह से हटाना): Refers to eliminating or getting rid of something entirely. • **Example:** The government is working hard to completely remove corruption from the system. • **Option 3 - To watch constantly** (लगातार निगरानी करना): Refers to keeping an eye on something or someone at all times. • **Example:** The security guard was instructed to watch the premises constantly during the night. • **Option 4 - To overpower fully** (पूरी तरह से काबू पाना): Refers to defeating or controlling someone or something completely. • **Example:** The team managed to overpower their rivals fully in the final match. 37:Ta02, The correct answer is: **Arson**.
